title: Accept menu items reading after the editor on desktop
context: more-formats-reach hosts the More formats and photo menus in a plain OverlayEntry so the macOS VoiceOver pointer reaches them. The macOS engine's pointer hit test walks children in reverse reading order, so a menu floating over the editor must come after it in reading order; the spec's 'items read right after the anchor' cannot hold with the pointer fix. Desktop order: More formats, Undo, Redo, Note, items; phone: items right after Redo. While a menu is open, a VoiceOver pointer outside it lands on the menu's empty full-screen group.
options: Accept PR 220 as built and amend the spec
Hold PR 220 and look for another hosting
outcome: Owner chose: accept. PR 220 stays as built; the spec's keep-line for 10.29 is amended to the new reading order.
